Chief_Complaint.content: Soreness and cracked skin on hands
Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: Soreness, cracked skin on hands

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Hand skin symptoms have been present for 3-4 months
Symptoms have worsened recently and are affecting work
Affected area is the palms of the hands
Symptoms include itchiness of the palms
There is occasional bleeding when the affected area is scratched
Patient tried E45 cream without relief
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Tried E45 cream and antihistamine without relief

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient tried an antihistamine without relief
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Tried E45 cream and antihistamine without relief

Assessment.content: Contact dermatitis is likely related to cleaning products and lack of glove use
Assessment.source_text: Likely related to cleaning products and lack of glove use

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise patient to wear gloves during cleaning
Recommend stronger emollients to be applied 3-4 times daily
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Recommend stronger emollients, apply 3-4 times daily

Plan_of_Care.content: Prescription to be sent to pharmacy
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Prescription to be sent to pharmacy

Follow_up_Information.content: Follow up in 1-2 weeks if no improvement or worsening of symptoms
